text:
Iris (Finance Ops): Heads up - reseller 'NeonGrid' says several seats auto-converted from trial to paid on 2024-10-11, but Azure settlement charged full month for those seats. Partner asked for a retro adjustment and wants to know if we should credit the customer or request marketplace reissue.

Derek (Partner Ops): Do we have the export slice? need subscription ids and report_date to confirm conversion timing. Also any promo/trial IDs attached?

Iris (Finance Ops): CSV snippet from Azure export:

```
subscription_id,sku,seat_count,unit_price,report_date,trial_flag
sub_ng001,azure-team-seat,50,15.00,2024-10-01,false
sub_ng001,azure-team-seat,70,15.00,2024-10-11,false
```

Customer had 20 trial seats prior to 10/11 that auto-converted that morning. Export shows 70 seats for whole period, not pro-rated. Gross overcharge estimated = 20 seats * $15 * (20/31) = $193.55 ~ $194.

Rowan (Revenue Ops): So gross refund ~ $194. Marketplace withholding per contract is 8% on refunds; reseller commission is 17% of net. Tax: reseller is US-based, no VAT. Is this under director threshold? It's <$1k but close.

Sandeep (Accounting): For any credit we need original invoice id and settlement run id. Please attach INV-AZ-20241031-NG and AZ-SET-20241031. JE lines: reverse revenue $194 DR; reverse commission accrual ~ $33 CR (17% of gross?) Wait commission usually on net after withholding; confirm calc. Also record marketplace withholding payable $15.52 CR (8%).

Derek (Partner Ops): Partner requests we issue provisional credit to avoid CS escalation. We'll request Azure amend export, but they say reissues take 2-3 settlement cycles. Recommend provisional credit with reclaim clause if Azure reimburses.

Azure Partner Bot: Created ticket AZ-CASE-22344: "export flattened incremental rows - NeonGrid". Case link: https://partner.azure.com/cases/22344

Rowan (Revenue Ops): Approve provisional credit up to $500 to keep customer happy, on condition of reclaim clause. Please mark as provisional CM-5222-P and tag FIN-5222.

Marta (Revenue Director): Approved provisional credit for this case. CC accounting when posting.

Iris (Finance Ops): Drafting provisional credit memo CM-5222-P for $194 gross. Withholding 8% = $15.52, net credit $178.48. Commission reversal: 17% of gross $32.98 -> reverse from commission accruals. Noting reclaim clause in memo: "If Azure reimburses Redwood within 90 days, we will reclaim the provisional amount from partner."

Sandeep (Accounting): OK to post provisional CM-5222-P, please attach CSV export and Azure case link. I'll prepare JE: 1) Reverse Sales $194 DR; 2) Commission accrual reversal $33 CR; 3) Marketplace withholding payable $15.52 CR. Round cents per GL rules.

Derek (Partner Ops): Partner signed acceptance acknowledging provisional credit and reclaim clause. Uploading signed PDF to FIN-5222.

Azure Partner Bot: Updated AZ-CASE-22344: Azure acknowledged export issue and will include amended lines in next settlement run.

Iris (Finance Ops): Posting provisional credit now and tagging FIN-5222. Will monitor Azure settlement and if reimbursement arrives we'll reverse provisional and reclaim from partner.

Sandeep (Accounting): Posted JE and attached supporting docs. Marking FIN-5222 status -> "provisional posted".

Rowan (Revenue Ops): Flag engineering to prevent flattening incremental rows for trial conversions. @eng-sre can you take a look at export pipeline?

Derek (Partner Ops): Notifying CS and partner success to close the loop with NeonGrid.

Iris (Finance Ops): Thanks everyone. Will update when Azure settlement contains amended lines or when reclaim is processed. :white_check_mark:
